title: Enemy AI and encounter composition
next_step: Survey written. Build game/data/combat/ai.json + game/src/combat/ai.js (RI-AI01 state machine), wire additively, then tools/harness/ai-probe.mjs (M1-M9, must go red on the pre-change tree), then browser confirmation.
overlap_note: W1-03 (water, state=fixed) claims game/data/combat/enemies/ and has touched game/src/combat/enemy.js. I do NOT write any statblock: the per-archetype AI parameters live in a NEW file game/data/combat/ai.json that this piece owns, precisely so the statblock directory is untouched. My enemy.js edits are additive (one new ai behaviour). W1-07 (encounter.js) and W1-POPULATION are both complete.
survey_findings: IMPLEMENTED_AI in game/src/combat/enemy.js is {none, hold_ground, scripted}. No approach, no circling, no pursuit. The AGGRO branch of _idleBehaviour sets b.state='REPOSITION' and only turns yaw - nothing writes b.pos. Confirms the water builder.

There IS one pursuit locomotion and the water builder missed it: character/encounter.js::engageMember (W1-07). Every wilderness body spawns through spawnEncounter, so it is stamped encounterId, so engageMember IS the shipped enemy AI of this game.

engageMember trips three of RI-AI01's five named hard fails by construction: constant attack_cadence_f=78 (M4 inter-COMMIT CoV=0), beeline-and-stand (M3 statue), and instant proximity aggro with no cone/LOS/meter (M1 circle + M2 no SUSPICIOUS ladder).
ENGAGE.advance_mps=2.20 is the only pursuit speed in the game. Player walk 2.0 / jog 3.2 / sprint 5.0. Nothing in this world can catch a jogging player.

wl-slitherfang-* aggro_at_m=20 vs beast_slitherfang sight_radius_m=16; wl-drowned-straggler aggro_at_m=16 vs drowned_lesser sight_radius_m=14. The encounter circle is LARGER than the declared sight radius, so those two aggro from behind, through walls, in the dark.
Roster: 7 combat statblocks over 3 of RI-AI05's 10 archetypes (INFANTRY, BEAST, CASTER). No TURTLE, DUELIST, POISE_MONSTER, RANGED, AMBUSHER, SWARM, BOSS. tier: 5 trash, 2 elite, 0 boss.
notes: Load at start: 18 headless_shell / loadavg 15.22; at survey end 24 / 19.19. All survey work above is offline source+data analysis, no browser.
